description: check on a declaration equal to the export: no drift, exit 0. The Action test replays these exchanges to the native binary.
source: The reads of export-all, less the Discussions read (export leaves Discussions out while they are off); the declaration is export-all's output.
declaration:
# repo-standard declaration for octo-org/hello-world
# Written by `repo-standard export` 0.1.0. Secrets are names only; values are never read.
# Remove a top-level key to stop managing that kind of resource.
repository:
  description: This your first repo!
  homepage: https://github.com
  topics:
  - octocat
  - atom
  - electron
  - api
  default_branch: master
  features:
    issues: true
    projects: true
    wiki: true
    discussions: false
  merge:
    allow_merge_commit: true
    allow_squash_merge: true
    allow_rebase_merge: true
    allow_auto_merge: false
    delete_branch_on_merge: true
  security:
    private_vulnerability_reporting: true
    dependabot_alerts: true
    dependabot_security_updates: true
labels:
- name: bug
  color: f29513
  description: Something isn't working
- name: enhancement
  color: a2eeef
  description: New feature or request
rulesets:
- name: Another ruleset
  target: branch
  enforcement: active
  bypass_actors:
  - actor_id: 234
    actor_type: Team
    bypass_mode: always
  conditions:
    ref_name:
      include:
      - refs/heads/main
      - refs/heads/master
      exclude:
      - refs/heads/dev*
  rules:
  - type: commit_author_email_pattern
    parameters:
      operator: contains
      pattern: github
- name: super cool ruleset
  target: branch
  enforcement: active
  bypass_actors:
  - actor_id: 234
    actor_type: Team
    bypass_mode: always
  conditions:
    ref_name:
      include:
      - refs/heads/main
      - refs/heads/master
      exclude:
      - refs/heads/dev*
  rules:
  - type: commit_author_email_pattern
    parameters:
      operator: contains
      pattern: github
environments:
- name: staging
  wait_timer: 30
  prevent_self_review: false
  reviewers:
  - type: User
    login: octocat
  - type: Team
    slug: justice-league
  deployment_branch_policy:
    protected_branches: false
    custom_branch_policies: true
  branch_policies:
  - name: main
    type: branch
  - name: release/*
    type: branch
  secrets:
  - GH_TOKEN
  - GIST_ID
secrets:
- GH_TOKEN
- GIST_ID
projects:
- title: Roadmap
  short_description: Where it is going
  readme: ""
  public: true
  closed: false
  status:
  - name: Todo
    color: GREEN
    description: This item hasn't been started
  - name: In Progress
    color: YELLOW
    description: This is actively being worked on
  - name: Done
    color: PURPLE
    description: This has been completed
actions:
  enabled: true
  allowed_actions: selected
  sha_pinning_required: true
  selected_actions:
    github_owned_allowed: true
    verified_allowed: false
    patterns_allowed:
    - docker/*
    - monalisa/octocat@*
  workflow:
    default_workflow_permissions: read
    can_approve_pull_request_reviews: true

options.name: In Progress
options.description: This is actively being worked on
